fragments.text: The concept of open government is embraced globally as the use and governance of data and digital technologies to improve transparency in government operations. And some of Africa is one of the founding members of the open government partnership that was established in 2011 to really drive this issue of the use and governance of data and digital technologies. The initiatives main aims are to promote transparency, to empower citizens and to fight corruption and to harness new technologies to strengthen governance. Now each member commits to an action plan, developed with public consultation and committed to reporting on the progress. Now this is a mechanism that could be used by the public accounts committees as well to understand the commitments towards these particular ideals by many of the countries that are there.
